practicalInfo.title: 🥬 Vegetarian Phrase Card
items: "Watashi wa bejitarian desu" — I am vegetarian
"Niku, sakana, dashi nashi de onegaishimasu" — No meat, fish, or dashi please
"Kore wa niku ga haitte imasu ka?" — Does this contain meat?
"Yasai dake de onegaishimasu" — Vegetables only please
Show your phone with the Japanese text if pronunciation is tricky — most staff will understand written Japanese better
Download the "Is It Vegan Japan" app — scans ingredient labels in Japanese

practicalInfo.title: 🏧 Money Tips
items: Japan is still partly cash-based — carry ¥20,000-30,000 in cash
7-Eleven ATMs accept international cards (Visa/Mastercard) with no issues
IC cards (Suica/Pasmo) work at konbini, vending machines, and many restaurants
Budget hotels and small restaurants often accept cash only
Tipping is NOT customary and can cause confusion

practicalInfo.title: ⛩️ Cultural Tips
items: Remove shoes when entering temples, ryokans, and some restaurants (look for a step up)
Bow slightly when greeting — a small nod is sufficient for tourists
Do not eat while walking — find a bench or stand by the food stall
Trash cans are rare — carry a small bag for rubbish (konbini have bins)
Trains are silent zones — keep voices low and phones on manner mode
Onsen etiquette: Shower thoroughly before entering the bath, no swimwear, small towel stays dry on your head

practicalInfo.title: 🚨 Golden Week Survival Tips
items: Apr 29 (Showa Day), Apr 30 (bridge holiday), May 3 (Constitution Day), May 4 (Greenery Day), May 5 (Children's Day)
Book ALL attractions with advance tickets NOW — teamLab, Ghibli, ryokan
Trains will be packed — avoid rush hours (7:30-9:30, 17:00-19:00)
Popular day trip destinations (Kamakura, Hakone, Nikko) are busiest — go EARLY
Coin lockers at major stations fill up fast — use luggage forwarding (takkyubin) instead
Many Japanese take the entire week off — enjoy the festive, holiday atmosphere!

practicalInfo.title: 📱 Useful Apps
items: Google Maps — best for train navigation (real-time schedules)
Hyperdia or Navitime — alternative train planners
Is It Vegan Japan — ingredient scanner for packaged food
HappyCow — find vegetarian/vegan restaurants nearby
Tabelog — Japan's #1 restaurant review app (Japanese but translatable)
Google Translate — camera mode translates Japanese text in real-time
